items.source: This can either be a traditional PlatformTransactionManager or a ReactiveTransactionManager for reactive transaction management.
items.translation: 这可以是传统的 `PlatformTransactionManager`，或者是用于响应式事务管理的 `ReactiveTransactionManager`。

items.source: in favor of determineTransactionManager(TransactionAttribute, Class)
items.translation: 支持determineTransactionManager(TransactionAttribute, Class)。

items.source: Determine the specific transaction manager to use for the given transaction.
items.translation: 确定给定事务要使用的具体事务管理器。

items.source: txAttr - the TransactionAttribute (may be null)
items.translation: txAttr - 事务属性（可能为 null）

items.source: joinpointIdentification - the fully qualified method name (used for monitoring and logging purposes)
items.translation: joinpointIdentification - 完全限定的方法名（用于监控和日志记录）

items.source: txInfo - information about the current transaction
items.translation: txInfo - 当前事务的信息

items.source: Uses the Strategy design pattern. A PlatformTransactionManager or ReactiveTransactionManager implementation will perform the actual transaction management, and a TransactionAttributeSource (for example, annotation-based) is used for determining transaction definitions for a particular class or method.
items.translation: 使用策略设计模式。PlatformTransactionManager或ReactiveTransactionManager的实现将执行实际的事务管理，而TransactionAttributeSource（例如基于注解的）则用于确定特定类或方法的事务定义。

items.source: The default implementation returns null, indicating the use of DefaultTransactionAttribute.getDescriptor() instead, ending up as ClassUtils.getQualifiedMethodName(Method, Class).
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `null`，表示使用DefaultTransactionAttribute.getDescriptor()，最终变为ClassUtils.getQualifiedMethodName(Method, Class)。

items.source: This can either point to a traditional PlatformTransactionManager or a ReactiveTransactionManager for reactive transaction management.
items.translation: 这可以指向传统的 PlatformTransactionManager，或者用于响应式事务管理的 ReactiveTransactionManager。

items.source: If no transaction name has been specified in the TransactionAttribute, the exposed name will be the fully-qualified class name + "." + method name (by default).
items.translation: 如果未在TransactionAttribute中指定事务名称，则暴露的名称默认为完全限定类名 + "." + 方法名。

items.source: A transaction aspect is serializable if its TransactionManager and TransactionAttributeSource are serializable.
items.translation: 如果其 `TransactionManager` 和 `TransactionAttributeSource` 是可序列化的，则该事务切面是可序列化的。

items.source: To find out about specific transaction characteristics, consider using TransactionSynchronizationManager's isSynchronizationActive() and/or isActualTransactionActive() methods.
items.translation: 要查询特定事务特性，请考虑使用 `TransactionSynchronizationManager` 的 `isSynchronizationActive()` 和/或 `isActualTransactionActive()` 方法。

items.source: This exposes the locally declared transaction boundary with its declared name and characteristics, as managed by the aspect. Ar runtime, the local boundary may participate in an outer transaction: If you need transaction metadata from such an outer transaction (the actual resource transaction) instead, consider using TransactionSynchronizationManager.
items.translation: 这暴露了由切面管理的、具有其声明名称和特性的本地声明事务边界。在运行时，该本地边界可能会参与一个外部事务：如果您需要来自此类外部事务（即实际资源事务）的事务元数据，请考虑使用 TransactionSynchronizationManager。

items.source: A TransactionInfo will be returned even if no transaction was created. The TransactionInfo.hasTransaction() method can be used to query this.
items.translation: 即使未创建事务，也会返回一个 `TransactionInfo`。可以使用 `TransactionInfo.hasTransaction()` 方法来查询此信息。

items.source: The default transaction manager will be used if a qualifier has not been declared for a given transaction or if an explicit name for the default transaction manager bean has not been specified.
items.translation: 如果未为给定事务声明限定符，或者未指定默认事务管理器 Bean 的显式名称，则将使用默认的事务管理器。

items.source:
This enables the underlying Spring transaction infrastructure to be used easily
to implement an aspect for any aspect system.
items.translation: 这使得底层 Spring 事务基础设施能够被轻松利用，以针对任何面向切面系统实现一个切面。

items.source: Subclasses are responsible for calling methods in this class in the correct order.
items.translation: 子类负责按正确顺序调用此类中的方法。

items.source:
Note: Method names are always applied to the target class,
no matter if defined in an interface or the class itself.
items.translation: 注意：无论方法是在接口中定义还是在类本身中定义，方法名始终应用于目标类。

items.source:
Internally, a NameMatchTransactionAttributeSource will be
created from the given properties.
items.translation: 内部将根据给定的属性创建一个 NameMatchTransactionAttributeSource。

items.source:
Allows callers to perform custom TransactionAttribute lookups through
the TransactionAttributeSource.
items.translation: 允许调用者通过 TransactionAttributeSource 执行自定义的 TransactionAttribute 查找。

items.source: Call this in all cases: exception or normal return!
items.translation: 在所有情况下都调用此方法：异常或正常返回！

items.source: General delegate for around-advice-based subclasses, delegating to several other template methods on this class. Able to handle CallbackPreferringPlatformTransactionManager as well as regular PlatformTransactionManager implementations and ReactiveTransactionManager implementations for reactive return types.
items.translation: 用于基于环绕建议的子类的通用委托，将调用此类上的几个其他模板方法。能够处理 CallbackPreferringPlatformTransactionManager 以及常规的 PlatformTransactionManager 实现，以及用于反应式返回类型的 ReactiveTransactionManager 实现。

attributes. Will build a CompositeTransactionAttributeSource for the given sources.
items.translation: 设置多个用于查找事务属性的事务属性源。将为给定的源构建一个 `CompositeTransactionAttributeSource`。

items.source:
Set the transaction attribute source which is used to find transaction
attributes. If specifying a String property value, a PropertyEditor
will create a MethodMapTransactionAttributeSource from the value.
items.translation: 设置用于查找事务属性的事务属性源。如果指定字符串属性值，PropertyEditor 将从该值创建一个 MethodMapTransactionAttributeSource。

items.source:
Execute after successful completion of call, but not after an exception was handled.
Do nothing if we didn't create a transaction.
items.translation: 在调用成功完成后执行，但在异常被处理后不执行。如果未创建事务，则不执行任何操作。

items.source:
Handle a throwable, completing the transaction.
We may commit or roll back, depending on the configuration.
items.translation:
处理异常，完成事务。
根据配置，我们可能会提交或回滚。
